notes: Poly Haven has no pine/fir trees beyond the Pine Forest collection (pine_tree_01 17M tris, fir_tree_01 7.8M, saplings 0.4-9.8M): all are very heavy and need decimation or LODs; no spruce, bamboo, maple, cedar or tropical canopy trees exist. Consider Quaternius/Kenney CC0 or procedural trees.

No Poly Haven models for mushrooms, pine cones, fallen leaves, firewood stacks, logs piles, vines, large tropical leaves, bamboo stalks, stone lanterns (toro), torii, shrine or temple pieces, Japanese roofs/houses, or stone stairs. Village architecture, bamboo grove and stone lanterns must be built procedurally or sourced elsewhere.
forest ground-clutter is thin (6): only dry_branches_medium_01, moss_01, root pieces, weeds; bark_debris_01 is a Karoo desert asset (362k tris) and is a weak fit.

jungle ruins-structures has no real ruin kit: modular_fort_01, large_castle_door, statue busts and rock faces are loose approximations; plan to model blocks/stairs from jungle-stone and mossy-ruin materials.
jungle plants: only a few tropical species (anthurium, calathea, pachira, fern); no palms, banana or monstera. island_tree_* are tagged jungle but are coastal trees with 1.7-4.8M tris.
village props: wooden_lantern_01 and Lantern_01 are the only lanterns (no paper/stone lanterns); keep an emissive paper-lantern prop procedural.
cabin props: no firewood or log pile models; hatchet/axes, stumps and barrel_stove are the closest. No snow-covered pine variants: pines are green, snow must be added with shader or decals.

Procedural ambientCG materials used where photoscans are absent: Moss002-004, Bamboo001-002, RoofingTiles*, Plaster001, Snow007-010 (Snow005/006/011-015 are photo), Ground040/049-051. Bamboo is paneling only (no round culm texture); 3 Poly Haven bamboo_wall photoscans plus 6 procedural ambientCG; last two bamboo entries are fill (Wicker008A, japanese_cedar_planks).

No dedicated Poly Haven moss or snow-covered-rock textures; moss candidates are mossy grounds/rocks/bark. Thatch-free village: roof tiles are generic ceramic/slate, not true Japanese kawara; grey_roof_tiles and black RoofingTiles009 are the nearest colours.

HDRIs: none have aurora. aurora-night uses clear starry night skies; add aurora via a shader or overlay (kloppenheim_02_puresky is a sky-only option). No snowy night HDRI with a mountain/cabin horizon: winter_evening and night_bridge are urban.

HDRIs: only 3 rain-tagged outdoor HDRIs (castel_st_angelo_roof, teufelsberg_roof, vignaioli_night), all urban/industrial. rainy-morning and jungle storm use overcast/stormy forest and hill skies; add rain with particles/post. No true tropical/jungle HDRIs exist; the rainforest_trail and bamboo_tunnel are the best.

HDRIs: blue-hour snow options are limited to winter_lake_01, rural_winter_roadside, birchwood (sunset with snow) and stierberg_sunrise; qwantani_dusk_* and kiara_9_dusk give the right twilight colour without snow.

Village lantern-dusk uses hill/forest dusk HDRIs; Japanese-garden HDRIs exist only for daylight (ninomaru_teien at sunrise, xiequ_yuan, chinese_garden). Check ninomaru_teien and others for sun direction/exposure in the viewer before choosing.
